work_units.notes: Static listing recovers two two-input/output handlers with RECIPS and three correction stages. Tested 0x04 inputs 1/0, 1/+inf, and NaN/1 likewise return 0xffffffff. The complete ten-vector result list is verified by von/tools/verify_sharc_reciprocal_edges.py. Repeating the probe with default DRC and -nodrc interpreter produced identical FIFO words, so there is no engine-specific discrepancy in this boundary set. Coordinate semantics and natural record format remain provisional. The instrumented 35-second twin capture contains repeated host-side 0x0d/0x17 writes but no SHARC 0x2034a or 0x20de1 execution, separating those writes as an i960/geometry command path.
